chapter_seo_title: Dao Gui Yi Xian Ch. 367: The Hole in the Sky – Heart-Turbid Terror
chapter_meta_description: Li Huowang escapes a mind-bending trap, but the true horror is revealed when he sees a literal hole in the sky. A visceral chapter of pain, love, and cosmic lies.
og_title: The Sky is a Lie: Chapter 367 of Dao Gui Yi Xian
og_description: He thought it was a hallucination. He was wrong. A missing piece of the heavens shows the true, terrifying power of a Heart-Turbid.
twitter_title: 🕳️ The Sky is GONE!? Ch. 367 of Dao Gui Yi Xian
twitter_description: Li Huowang escapes, but the world doesn't make sense. He just watched a piece of the sky get 'hidden.' The Dung-Beetle ritual's true price? Pure agony, not death. A brutal chapter.

lore_anchors.definition: A corrupted counterpart to the Heart-Element (心素). Its ability is to "hide" or erase concepts, objects, and even parts of the sky from reality.
A ritual of the Ao-Jing Sect that trades agonizing pain for a surge in power from the primordial god Bashe (巴虺).
The primordial, pain-feeding god worshipped by the Ao-Jing Sect. It feeds on suffering, not necessarily death.
The foundational artifact of the Ao-Jing Sect, a gruesome manual of rituals and sacrifices that trades extreme agony for power from Bashe.
